description: This PHP class defines the EmployeeWorkExperienceModel used in the OrangeHRM system. It implements serialization and normalizable interfaces to represent an employee's work experience data, including properties like company, job title, comments, dates, and education details. The class constructs itself with an EmpWorkExperience entity, setting filters and attribute names for serialization.

classes.name: EmployeeWorkExperienceModel
classes.description: A model representing an employee's work experience data, capable of serialization and normalization within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EmployeeWorkExperienceModel with an EmpWorkExperience entity, setting filters and attribute mappings for serialization.
